annotator_limitation: LLM labels, not human review, and a SINGLE pass -- no second annotator, so no inter-annotator agreement (kappa) can be computed. This is weaker than the two-pass protocol in LABEL_AGREEMENT_REPORT.md. Acceptable for a go/no-go feasibility probe; NOT acceptable as benchmark ground truth.
blinding: Labelled from experiments/results/disagreement_probe_blinded.json only. The key file (group, solution values, agreement flags) was not opened until after all 40 labels were fixed. The AgentPulse detector was not run at any point before labelling.
criterion: CONTRADICTION requires the two outputs to assert claims that cannot both be true. Procedural remarks ('I need to re-evaluate', 'let us continue'), parallel improvement suggestions, and restatement in different words are NOT contradictions.
